findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.affected_population_system: Following a November 22 visit to a displacement site after a sand dune collapse, humanitarian partners are working to facilitate voluntary relocation of high-risk families to an Egyptian Committee-managed site with additional shelters. No completed relocation or family count confirmed.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: efforts are underway to facilitate the voluntary relocation of families at high risk.

bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Specific relocation response not in reviewed ledger; distinct from earlier collapse casualty reports and general flood risk.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Older report detail recovered this run; exact event and relocation start dates unknown, no verified completion or onset within observation hour. Relationship to other reported dune collapses unknown.

findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.location: Al Shifa, Al Aqsa and Nasser Medical Complex, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: During November 17–23, OCHA reports training 111 doctors in disease surveillance and laboratory sampling and development of a unified meningitis case-management, classification and sampling protocol with the National Infectious Disease Committee. This is a specific response-capacity development, not evidence that shortages or diagnostic constraints have been resolved.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: a unified protocol was developed on the case management and classification of meningitis cases and on laboratory sampling.

bounded_discovery_context.method: Full OCHA report lines 144–145; compared with 33 authenticated November 25–26 watch receipts.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Specific completed training and protocol development distinct from prior recorded outbreak, admissions and lab confirmation gap.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Previously published detail newly recovered; no verified event within hour; actual improvement in diagnostic turnaround or outcomes unconfirmed.
